title: Hearty Roasted Portuguese Cheese Casserole
description: A rich and flavorful Portuguese-inspired casserole featuring roasted vegetables, melted cheese, and a hint of lime juice, made with macrobiotic-friendly ingredients and pressure-cooked for added convenience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked brown rice, black beans, roasted sweet potatoes, and shredded cheese.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lime juice and olive oil.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl with the lime juice mixture and stir to combine.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until everything is well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes.
While the casserole is baking, heat a pressure cooker with a little bit of oil over medium heat.
Once the casserole is done, remove it from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Use the pressure cooker to add a crispy crust to the top of the casserole.
